questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Angad says that / he follows / his exercise regimen strictly / and that helping to him stay fit.

options.text: and that helping to him stay fit.

questions.solution:
The segment that contains a grammatical error is '**and that helping to him stay fit.**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Using the verb **'help'** with or without a** 'to infinitive'.** The meaning remains the same.
 
• **Help** is a verb that can be used **with or without to** and with or without an object before the infinitive.
 
• When we use it with an infinitive it sometimes **sounds more informal**.
 
• **Helping to **shall be replaced by **helps.**

 

Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

Hence, the corrected sentence is: *Angad says that he follows his exercise regimen strictly and**** that helps him stay fit.***

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

From these findings, we can ______ that the rate of crime is increasing in the city.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'infer.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Infer** means to form an opinion or decide that something is true from the information you have.

 ​ ** -Example:** Jack's answers to my questions during our interview allowed me to infer that he was not the right candidate for the position.

So, it is clear that the most appropriate word is **'infer'.**

The complete sentence is **"From these findings, we can infer__ that the rate of crime is increasing in the city.".**

​

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

• **Summarise** means to tell in or reduce to a summary.
 
• **Presume** means to think that something is true even if you do not know for sure; to suppose.

questions.question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

An outgoing, socially confident person
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**Extrovert**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• '**Extrovert**' means a person who is confident and full of life and who prefers being with other people to being alone.

 -Example: Most sales person are extroverts.

So it is clear that '**Extrovert**' can be used as a one-word substitute for '**An outgoing, socially confident person.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Introvert** means a quiet, shy person who prefers to be alone than with other people.
 
• **Brooder** means a person who broods about something.
 
• **Solitary** means a person enjoys being alone; frequently spending time alone.

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

questions.question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Delay an event to a later date or time
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Postpone'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Postpone'** means to arrange that something will happen at a later time than the time you had planned; to delay.

 **-Example:** The match was postponed because of rain.

So it is clear that **'Postpone'** can be used as a one-word substitute for **'Delay an event to a later date or time.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prepone** means to change the time or date of an event so that it takes place earlier; to advance something.

 
 
• **Example**: The government might **prepone **these elections so we'd better be prepared.
 
 
 
• **Preserve** means to keep something safe or in good condition.
 
 
• **Example**: The agreement **preserved **our right to limit trade in endangered species.
 
 
 
• **Persevere** means to continue trying to do or achieve something that is difficult.​
 
 
• **Example**: We will **persevere **in this struggle for peace, no matter how long it takes.
